user.title: Tablo
user.description: Enter the local address of your Tablo 4th Gen DVR. No Tablo account login is needed.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Tablo.
error.invalid_auth: The Tablo rejected the request signature.

init.title: Live TV
init.description: To play live TV on players that can't decode MPEG-2 (Apple TV, browsers, Chromecast), enter the URL of a tablo-web server to transcode streams to H.264. Leave empty to send the Tablo's raw stream.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach tablo-web at that URL.
error.transcoder_not_logged_in: tablo-web is running but isn't logged in to a Tablo.

watch_channel.name: Watch channel
watch_channel.description: Plays a live TV channel on one or more media players as video. Use this for Apple TVs, which only play audio from the Media panel.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: Channel number (5.1), call sign (KOCO) or the full name shown in the channel picker. Defaults to the Live TV channel picker.

config_entry_id.name: Tablo
config_entry_id.description: Which Tablo to use. Only needed if you have more than one.
